notes.title: Update Patch Notes - August 13, 2018
notes.content:
The following updates have been implemented:

Added Difficulty Options to the Settings.
Now you can choose from the Three Difficulties: Thumbsucker, Normal and Clint Westwood.

ThumbSucker = Less HP and Slower Bullets for the Enemies.
Clint Westwood = More HP and Faster Bullets for the Enemies.

Added / Fixed better movement on the map with the Thumbsticks on your Xbox360 controller.

Changed collision for Player with the Cow Skull on the Stampede mini-game.
If you hit the skull, your HP will be lowered. (you'll not lose a whole life like before)

Added Two New Achievements.

ThumbSucker - Finish the game on the "ThumbSucker" difficulty.
Guardian of the Lost Treasure - Finish the game on the "Clint Westwood" difficulty.

Fixed "collision bug" with the Train.



Enjoy the game! :)

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - August 2, 2018
notes.content:
The following updates have been implemented:

Added better and smoother movement for crosshair.
(Especially with Thumbstick on the controller.)

Lowered the game difficulty for some of the enemies.
Indian boat can fire only 2 shots. Enemy from the lake can throw only one knife.

Fixed the chicken collision with Dynamite and Bomb explosion.
The poor Chickens... :(


Happy gaming! :)

notes.title: Gunman Tales Finally Leaves Early Access!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32811583/8fa8d3ddee81154b7af40c716349c8237f9b72f1.png

Hooray! The release of Gunman Tales is here! 

Thanks much to everyone who was supporting Gunman Tales during the Early Access. Thanks for all your suggestions and feedback, you're all awesome, really!

And special thanks to my lovely wife Silvia for her GREAT patience :) 


I will continue to gather your suggestions to improve the game. If anyone has good ideas about what they'd like to see, I'd love to hear them. :)


Have fun, folks!

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - August 1, 2018
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32811583/93409e4fb2ce45b1388c60935c577eeecd47162a.png

The following updates have been implemented:

Added Special Abilities for Each of the Characters:
Press the "V" or "E" on the Keyboard or "B" on the Controller.

Remember that the each ability need to be fully charged before use.
The time for fully recharge is 10 sec.

Red Gunman have "Bombs"
Green Gunman "Burst Shot"
Blue Gunman can "Freeze Time"
and Yellow Gunman have nice "Boomerang"

Added 1UP Power-Up like in the Super Mario (Green Mushroom)
Finally, you can raise number of your lives. Of course it's rare Power-Up.

Added Toxic Mushroom "Power-Up"  ...Power-Up??!
Don't eat this Mushroom... really.

Added Hammer Power-Up
Now, you can fortify yourself by building a barricades!

Changed / Reduced the difficulty in the "Stagecoach" quest.

Updated in-game and PDF manual.
I'm really recomended to read this manual before your first game. :)

Fixed some graphical glitches.


Enjoy the game!


ps. Gunman Tales is Leaving Early Access in a few hours! Stay Tuned! :)

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - July 23, 2018
notes.content:
The following updates have been implemented:

Added a New Quest from Sheriff: Lasso the Cows
Inspired by the legendary Stampede from Atari 2600!

Added a New Quest from Sheriff: The Train Robbery
Deal with the Bandits in the Train!
Use X,C,V for Fire  (X,Y,B on the controller)

Added New Achievement: Cattle Baron
Gotta Catch 'Em All!  Pokecow! :D

Fixed "Mulder" Achievement

Added support for Mouse in the Arcade Stages!
Go to the Settings and turn the Mouse ON.
If you use the mouse, use the W,A,S,D keys.

Added Exit (Pause) feature for Controller.
Press the START button on your Xbox360 controller and the exit menu will pop-up.

Added support for "Double Tap" Roll in the Arcade Stages.
Press fast 2x Left Arrow or Right Arrow for "roll". Of course, you can also use the controller.

Fixed Hi-Score save bug in the Arcade Stages.
Your hi-score will be now stored correctly.

Added a new HELP tables for Arcade and Quest (minigame) stages.
Just press "P" for Pause and you will see "How To Play".

Fixed some graphical glitches.


Enjoy this huge update and have a nice day! :)

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - July 5, 2018
notes.content:
The following updates have been implemented:

Fixed a serious bug with the Shaman's curse of horse poop.
It was impossible to continue in the game if more players was cursed or you was the last player.

Added NEW Arcade mode for 1-2 players.
Enjoy the Arcade stages with your friend!

Added Xbox360 thumbstick support for the "outlaw chase" stage.

Fixed bug with the Trees in the "Old Mine" action stage.
One of the two trees had no "health" points.

Fixed some bugs in the text. "wll" > "will" etc.

Fixed some graphical glitches.

Added NEW Achievement "Mulder"
Try to find the Alien Corpse at the end of the game.

Added NEW TNT Exploding Barrels to the arcade stages.

Added NEW Power-Up "Cow Horn".
A very useful thing that allows you to summon a great Cattle Stampede.

Added the W,A,S,D and J,K,L keys as the next option to control the game.
W,A,S,D = Arrows
J,K,L = X,C,Space

Changed: Warning Message about the new game (old save) was moved to the next screen (mode select)


Big thanks to (The 80s man) for bug reports.
(there were really a lot of bugs... :D)

Enjoy the game! :)

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - June 22, 2018
notes.content:
The following updates have been implemented:

Changed Save Game system.
Due to future updates, i completely changed the save game system. The old save system was broken if i added a new things into the game. Due to this, it's possible that your old save will not load. I'm really sorry. :( 

And now, the good things! :)

Added the Notification Message about your old save.
If you have saved game and want to start the new game, the pop-up notification window will appear.

Changed Quest system from the Sheriff.
If you finish your current quest, wait three turns and try to visit the sheriff office again. Sheriff will be have more work for you. If your quest was succesfull, you'll obtain xp, gold or items automaticaly.

Added NEW quest/mini game from the Sheriff.
Now you can protect the stagecoach full of the money. Yee-haw! :D

Changed the Hi-Lo card game in the Saloon.
Now you need to guess three cards in the row. Cost to play is $25.
If you have luck you can win $100!  Good luck stranger! 

Fixed Crosshair hitbox in the Arcade Stages.
From now, no enemy and chicken will be spared!

Fixed bug with the Old Spyglass.
If all the players was dead and you used the Spyglass the game freezed.

Added a special typing effect to the text.
Visit the Saloon or Shaman and see.

I fixed more small things and bugs, but now i don't remember what was it. haha :D


Enjoy the game and have a nice day!

ps. The next update will be out soon!

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - Jun 6, 2018
notes.content:
The following updates have been implemented:

Added support for Thumbstick on Xbox 360 controller
Now you can controll the game with the left thumbstick.

Added info about Thumbsticks on "How To Play" screen.

Added smoother movement for Crosshair in the Arcade Stages.

Fixed (i hope) "game freeze" in some arcade stages.
In the end of the stage sometime the game stopped.

Fixed the left corner button in the Duel Stage.
If you played with Xbox 360 controller, button had wrong graphics. (keyboard)


Enjoy the game and have a nice day!


ps. Don't forget to check out the "How To Play" screen in the main menu, it's really helpfull. :)
